# Load libraries
```{r}
library(package = "deSolve")
```

# Create general functions
```{r}
# Function for keeping values positive that we pass to ode()
  posfun <- function(t, y, parms){
    with(as.list(y), {
      y[which( y <0.001)] <- 0  
      return(y)
    })
  }
```


# One resource, one species
```{r}
# Create function
  oneRoneS <- function(t, y, parms) {
    with(as.list(c(y, parms)), {
      dR <- r*R - alpha*R*R - beta*R*N
      dN <- b*N*R - m*N
      return(list(c(dR, dN)))
    })
  }

# Define arguments that we pass to our numerical solver, ode()
  # A time vector
  max_time <- 100
  time_vec <- seq(from = 0, to = max_time, length.out = 1e5)
  # Initial values for each variable
  init_vec <- c(R = 1, N = 0.01)
  # Parameter values
  parm_vec <- c(r = 0.9, alpha = 1, beta = 0.5, b = 0.5, m = 0.2)

# Solve initial value problem with our numerical solver, ode
  odeOut_1R1S <- ode(y = init_vec, times = time_vec, parms = parm_vec, func = oneRoneS)

# Look at the relationship between R and per-capita rates
  no_Rs <- 1e4
  R_vec <- seq(from = 0, to = 1, length.out = no_Rs)
  birth <- parm_vec["b"]*R_vec
  death <- parm_vec["m"]*R_vec^0

# Find R*
  Rstar <- parm_vec["m"]/parm_vec["b"]

# Plot R and per-capita rates next to the time series
  # Make 1 row and 2 columns of graphs
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 0.1, 0.1))
  # R and per-capita rates
  plot(x = R_vec, y = birth, type = "l", xlab = "Resource (R)", ylab = "Per-capita rate", las = 1, lwd = 2, col = "seagreen1")
  lines(x = R_vec, y = death, lwd = 2, col = "tomato")
  abline(v = Rstar)
  legend(x = "bottomright", legend = c("R*", "PC birth", "PC death"), col = c("black", "seagreen1", "tomato"), lwd = 2, bty = "n")
# Plot time series
  max_y <- max(odeOut_1R1S[,-1])
  plot(x = NA, xlim = c(0, max_time), xlab = "Time", ylab = "Density", las = 1, ylim = c(0, max_y))
  lines(x = odeOut_1R1S[,1], y = odeOut_1R1S[,2], lwd = 2, col = "black")
  lines(x = odeOut_1R1S[,1], y = odeOut_1R1S[,3], lwd = 2, col = "blue")
  abline(h = Rstar)
  legend(x = "right", legend = c("R", "N"), col = c("black", "blue"), lwd = 2, bty = "n")
```






# One resource, two species
```{r message=FALSE}
# Create function
  oneRtwoS <- function(t, y, parms) {
    with(as.list(c(y, parms)), {
      dR <- r*R - alpha*R*R - beta1*R*N1 - beta2*R*N2
      dN1 <- b1*N1*R - m1*N1
      dN2 <- b2*N2*R - m2*N2
      return(list(c(dR, dN1, dN2)))
    })
  }

# Define arguments that we pass to our numerical solver, ode()
  # A time vector
  max_time <- 100
  time_vec <- seq(from = 0, to = max_time, length.out = 1e5)
  # Initial values for each variable
  init_vec <- c(R = 1, N1 = 0.01, N2 = 0.02)
  # Parameter values
  parm_vec <- c(r = 0.9, alpha = 1, beta1 = 0.5, beta2 = 0.5, b1 = 0.55, m1 = 0.15, b2 = 0.5, m2 = 0.2)

# Solve initial value problem with our numerical solver, ode
  odeOut_1R2S <- ode(y = init_vec, times = time_vec, parms = parm_vec, func = oneRtwoS, events=list(func = posfun, time = c(0:max_time)))

# Look at the relationship between R and per-capita rates
  no_Rs <- 1e4
  R_vec <- seq(from = 0, to = 1, length.out = no_Rs)
  birth_1 <- parm_vec["b1"]*R_vec
  death_1 <- parm_vec["m1"]*R_vec^0
  birth_2 <- parm_vec["b2"]*R_vec
  death_2 <- parm_vec["m2"]*R_vec^0

# Find R*
  Rstar_1 <- parm_vec["m1"]/parm_vec["b1"]
  Rstar_2 <- parm_vec["m2"]/parm_vec["b2"]

# Plot R and per-capita rates next to the time series
  # Make 1 row and 2 columns of graphs
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 0.1, 0.1))
  # R and per-capita rates
  plot(x = R_vec, y = birth_1, type = "l", xlab = "Resource (R)", ylab = "Per-capita rate", las = 1, lwd = 2, col = "seagreen1")
  lines(x = R_vec, y = death_1, lwd = 2, col = "tomato")
  lines(x = R_vec, y = birth_2, lwd = 2, col = "seagreen")
  lines(x = R_vec, y = death_2, lwd = 2, col = "tomato3")
  abline(v = c(Rstar_1, Rstar_2))
  legend(x = "bottomright", legend = c("R*", "PC birth", "PC death"), col = c("black", "seagreen1", "tomato"), lwd = 2, bty = "n")
# Plot time series
  max_y <- max(odeOut_1R2S[,-1])
  plot(x = NA, xlim = c(0, max_time), xlab = "Time", ylab = "Density", las = 1, ylim = c(0, max_y))
  lines(x = odeOut_1R2S[,1], y = odeOut_1R2S[,2], lwd = 2, col = "black")
  lines(x = odeOut_1R2S[,1], y = odeOut_1R2S[,3], lwd = 2, col = "blue")
  lines(x = odeOut_1R2S[,1], y = odeOut_1R2S[,4], lwd = 2, col = "red")
  abline(h = c(Rstar_1, Rstar_2))
  legend(x = "right", legend = c("R", "N1", "N2"), col = c("black", "blue", "red"), lwd = 2, bty = "n")
```

# Two resources, two species
```{r eval = F}
# Create function
  twoRtwoS <- function(t, y, parms) {
    with(as.list(c(y, parms)), {
      dR1 <- r1*R1 - alpha1*R1*R1 - beta11*R1*N1 - beta12*R1*N2
      dR2 <- r2*R2 - alpha2*R2*R2 - beta21*R2*N1 - beta22*R2*N2
      dN1 <- b11*N1*R1 + b12*N1*R2 - m1*N1
      dN2 <- b21*N2*R1 + b22*N2*R2 - m2*N2
      return(list(c(dR1, dR2, dN1, dN2)))
    })
  }

# Define arguments that we pass to our numerical solver, ode()
  # A time vector
  max_time <- 100
  time_vec <- seq(from = 0, to = max_time, length.out = 1e5)
  # Initial values for each variable
  init_vec <- c(R = 1, N1 = 0.01, N2 = 0.02)
  # Parameter values
  parm_vec <- c(r1 = 0.9, r2 = 0.9, alpha1 = 1, alpha2 = 1, beta11 = 0.5, beta12 = 0.5, beta21 = 0.6, beta22 = 0.6, b11 = 0.55, b12 = 0.45, b21 = 0.4, b22 = 0.6, m1 = 0.15, b2 = 0.5, m2 = 0.2)

# Solve initial value problem with our numerical solver, ode
  odeOut_2R2S <- ode(y = init_vec, times = time_vec, parms = parm_vec, func = oneRoneS, events=list(func = posfun, time = c(0:max_time)))

# Look at the relationship between R and per-capita rates
  no_Rs <- 1e4
  R_vec <- seq(from = 0, to = 1, length.out = no_Rs)
  birth_1 <- parm_vec["b1"]*R_vec
  death_1 <- parm_vec["m1"]*R_vec^0
  birth_2 <- parm_vec["b2"]*R_vec
  death_2 <- parm_vec["m2"]*R_vec^0

# Find R*
  Rstar_1 <- parm_vec["m1"]/parm_vec["b1"]
  Rstar_2 <- parm_vec["m2"]/parm_vec["b2"]

# Plot R and per-capita rates next to the time series
  # Make 1 row and 2 columns of graphs
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 0.1, 0.1))
  # R and per-capita rates
  plot(x = R_vec, y = birth_1, type = "l", xlab = "Resource (R)", ylab = "Per-capita rate", las = 1, lwd = 2, col = "seagreen1")
  lines(x = R_vec, y = death_1, lwd = 2, col = "tomato")
  lines(x = R_vec, y = birth_2, lwd = 2, col = "seagreen")
  lines(x = R_vec, y = death_2, lwd = 2, col = "tomato3")
  abline(v = c(Rstar_1, Rstar_2), lty = 2)
  legend(x = "bottomright", legend = c("R*", "PC birth", "PC death"), col = c("black", "seagreen1", "tomato"), lwd = 2, bty = "n", lty = c(2, 1, 1))
# Plot time series
  max_y <- max(odeOut_1R2S[,-1])
  plot(x = NA, xlim = c(0, max_time), xlab = "Time", ylab = "Density", las = 1, ylim = c(0, max_y))
  lines(x = odeOut_1R2S[,1], y = odeOut_1R2S[,2], lwd = 2, col = "black")
  lines(x = odeOut_1R2S[,1], y = odeOut_1R2S[,3], lwd = 2, col = "blue")
  lines(x = odeOut_1R2S[,1], y = odeOut_1R2S[,4], lwd = 2, col = "red")
  abline(h = c(Rstar_1, Rstar_2), lty = 2)
  legend(x = "right", legend = c("R", "N1", "N2"), col = c("black", "blue", "red"), lwd = 2, bty = "n")
```
